description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldImage class, a custom widget extending SugarWidgetFieldVarchar, responsible for rendering image links in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM list view with a click-to-view behavior.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldImage
classes.description: A widget class for rendering image links in list views, extending SugarWidgetFieldVarchar.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Generates an HTML link to display an image in a lightbox, using the list value and a translation for the link text.
